back: The orchard has been switched off/extinguished (put out), so {kg} kg is not in the weight above: {names}. The rand total still counts everything that was sold, including the orchard.
flags: icishiwe literally 'has been put out / switched off' (as a fire or light); unclear whether it means turned off/hidden/excluded in-app or physically closed
'ayikho esisindweni esingenhla' is stiff ('is not in the weight above'); 'esingenhla' fine but 'esisindweni' locative of isisindo reads awkwardly
'sisabala' (still counts) is acceptable but could be read as 'still calculates'
